findings.description: Non-manager restriction is described as a UI hide, not a data-layer control; a hidden control still returns rows to anyone who queries the table directly. Enforce with a security role or field-level security, not the client.
findings.evidence: "Access is hidden in the UI for non-managers."

findings.description: The approval threshold that gates submission is left unspecified, so the gate rule cannot be built or tested and downstream stages will guess at it.
Managers are granted read across every region with no stated need-to-know scoping; confirm cross-region visibility is actually required rather than assumed.
findings.evidence: The design says "Managers get a read only view across regions" without justifying the cross-region scope.
